skills.name: Monthly Bookkeeping Close Checklist
skills.description: Step-by-step month-end accounting close workflow: reconcile bank feeds, verify accruals, review Profit and Loss variances, and lock the QuickBooks ledger.
skills.content:
# Monthly Bookkeeping Close SOP
1. Run `quickbooks__reconcile_bank_feed` for every operating account.
2. Pull `quickbooks__list_profit_and_loss` and `quickbooks__get_balance_sheet`.
3. Flag expenses > 15% over budget and send overdue reminders.

skills.name: Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff Triage Runbook
skills.description: Operational incident runbook for diagnosing CrashLoopBackOff pods, OOMKilled containers, inspecting previous logs, checking node capacity, and safely rolling back.
skills.content:
# CrashLoopBackOff Runbook
1. Run `k8s__get_pods` to locate restarting pods.
2. Fetch `k8s__get_pod_logs` with `previous: true`.
3. Check `k8s__describe_node` for memory pressure before `k8s__rollout_restart`.

skills.name: Figma Design Tokens Export
skills.description: Design-system workflow for auditing Figma color and typography styles and exporting structured CSS custom properties and JSON design tokens.
skills.content:
# Figma to Design Tokens
1. Call `figma__get_styles` and `figma__get_figma_data`.
2. Map color/font styles to semantic token names.
3. Output tokens.css and tokens.json.

skills.name: Enterprise QBR Deck Preparation
skills.description: Account management playbook to assemble a Quarterly Business Review deck from HubSpot companies, open deals, call notes, and renewal risks.
skills.content:
# Enterprise QBR Prep
1. Call `hubspot__list_companies` and `hubspot__search_contacts`.
2. Summarize call notes and renewal stage.
3. Draft executive QBR outline.

skills.name: HIPAA Compliant Clinical Record Export
skills.description: Healthcare compliance SOP for exporting patient lab results and medication summaries while stripping PHI identifiers per HIPAA Safe Harbor rules.
skills.content:
# HIPAA Record Export SOP
1. Fetch `health_fhir__get_lab_results` and `health_fhir__list_medications`.
2. Redact all 18 Safe Harbor identifiers.
3. Generate audit-logged summary.

skills.name: S3 Cold Archive Lifecycle Guide
skills.description: Cloud storage cost-optimization guide for identifying stale S3 buckets, transitioning objects to Glacier Deep Archive, and issuing temporary presigned download links.
skills.content:
# S3 Cold Archive Guide
1. Run `aws_s3__list_buckets`.
2. Apply `aws_s3__set_bucket_lifecycle` with `GLACIER` or `DEEP_ARCHIVE`.
3. Use `aws_s3__generate_presigned_url` when temporary retrieval is needed.
